title: Honey Bunny Kidz Story Time: 7 Stories & Songs with Pip Puppy, Lulu Lamb & Ollie Owl (36 min)

lines.text: Ah... ah... ACHOO!
Who sneezed? Can you guess?
It was you, Pip! Bless you!
Brrr! Is it hot or cold today?
Cold! It's the first chilly day!
My nose is cold. My ears are cold. Even my waggy tail is cold!
Oh, Pip! You need a cosy hat and a warm scarf. Come inside!
I found a hat! Hey... who turned off the sun?
Hee hee! Pip, that's Mama's big, big hat!
Where's Pip? Can you see me?
Peekaboo! Here I am!
That hat is too big for a little puppy. Let's find your very own cosy things!
Look, a hat! What colour is my hat?
Red! A red hat with a fluffy white pompom!
And here's a long scarf. What colour is the scarf?
Blue! Blue with white stripes. Wrap, wrap, wrap!
Now, mittens! How many mittens can you count?
One, two! Two yellow mittens, one for each paw!
Red hat, blue scarf, yellow mittens. Ta-da! I'm cosy now!
Can you put on a pretend hat? Pull it down over your ears!
Let's go play outside!
Uh-oh. My nose is tickly again. Ah... ah...
Wait, Pip! When we sneeze, we sneeze into our elbow.
My elbow? Where is my elbow?
It's the bendy part in the middle of your arm. Can you find your elbow?
ACHOO!
Into your elbow! Hooray, Pip!
Well done! Now the tiny sneeze germs don't fly onto your friends.
Let's practise together! Lift your elbow up. Ready?
A teeny, tiny sneeze. Ah... choo!
Now a big, silly sneeze! Ah... ah... ah... ACHOO!
Is your nose a little drippy? Use a tissue. Wipe, wipe.
Then into the bin it goes. Bye-bye, tissue!
And then, what do we do next? Can you guess?
Wash our paws!
Splish! Warm water, and soap. Bubbles on my paws!
Let's scrub and count to ten. Count with us!
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Scrub the fronts, the backs, and in between!
Look! Big bubbles floating up! How many bubbles can you see?
One, two, three! Three big bubbles!
Pop them with your finger! Pop, pop, pop!
Pop! Pop! Pop!
Rinse, rinse, and dry with the towel.
Clean, clean paws! Woof!
Hello, friends! Quack! Ooh, my beak is tickly. Ah... ah...
Wait, Dotty! Sneeze into your elbow!
But Pip, ducks don't have elbows like you!
Hmm. What can Dotty use? Can you think?
Her wing! Into your fluffy wing, Dotty!
Ah... ah... choo! Into my wing! Quack!
Hooray! Everybody can cover a sneeze!
I'm so proud of you! Cosy clothes, elbow sneezes, and clean paws.
And I helped Dotty, too! Let's sing our Achoo Song!
Hat on my head, my scarf is blue. Two yellow mittens, I'm cosy! Are you?
When my nose is tickly, what do I do?
Lift my elbow, achoo, achoo!
Achoo, achoo, into my elbow! A tissue for my nose, and off we go!
Wash, wash, wash my paws, count to ten! Now we're cosy friends again!
One more time! Lift your elbow and sing! Achoo, achoo, into my elbow!

Woof! Stay cosy, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!

Yay! It's Pip Puppy Takes Turns on the Swing. Let's watch!
Wheee! Higher, higher! Can you swing your arms like me?
Pip! Can I have a turn, please?
Not yet! I want to swing all day long!

scenes.banner: Pip Puppy Takes Turns on the Swing

lines.text: But there is only one swing. And I want a turn too.
Me too!
Me three! Quack!
One swing, and lots of friends. How many friends are waiting? Count with me!
One, two, three friends!
I can swing all by myself! Kick, kick, kick!
Whoosh!
Look! The wind blew leaves all over Pip!
Pfft, pfft! Tickly leaves! Who am I?
Hee hee! You're a leaf puppy!
A leaf puppy on a swing! Ha ha!
Hee hee. I'm a silly leaf puppy!
Pip, swinging is fun. And sharing is kind. Let's take turns!
Turns? But what if I never get another go?
You will! Each friend gets ten pushes. Then the next friend has a turn. And then you again!
While we wait, we stand back here, away from the swing. That keeps everyone safe.
Wheee! My turn first! Thank you, Pip!
Let's count Lulu's pushes. Can you count to ten with us?
One, two, three, four, five.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
Ten! That was so much fun!
Waiting is so, so long. What can I do while I wait?
We can play a leaf game!
A leaf game? Yes, please!
Look at this leaf. What colour is it?
Red! Like an apple!
And this one? What colour is my leaf?
Yellow, just like me! Quack!
And this leaf is brown, like my floppy ears!
My turn now! Wheee!
Is Honey going up high, or down low?
Up high! And down low! Up and down!
Eight, nine, ten! Honey, your turn is done!
Now it's my turn! I'm next!
Oh. I'm so small. I've never been on a swing.
Hmm. Dotty waited too. Dotty, you go first! I'll cheer for you!
Pip, that is so kind!
Quack, quack, wheee! I'm swinging!
Go, Dotty, go! Can you clap for Dotty with me?
Clap, clap!
Cheering for friends is fun too!
My turn again! Wheee!
And it feels even better, because I waited!
You waited so well, Pip!
Now everyone gets to play!
Let's sing our turn-taking song! Clap along!
My turn, your turn, that's the way we play!
Count to ten, then it's you. Hip, hip, hooray!
Clap, clap!
Wait a little, swing a little, up and down we go!
Sharing with my friends makes me happy so!
Clap, clap!
Taking turns means everyone gets to play.
Can you say it with me? My turn, your turn!
Let's take a big swing breath. Breathe in, up high. And breathe out, down low.
Ahhh. So calm.
One more time! Swing your arms and sing! My turn, your turn, that's the way we play!

Woof woof! Bye-bye, friends! See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!
Are you ready for the next story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's Where Do Animals Sleep? with Pip Puppy. Let's watch!
Tweet, tweet!
Shh! Someone is sleeping up in the tree. Who can it be?
Little birds! In a cosy nest!

scenes.banner: Where Do Animals Sleep? with Pip Puppy

lines.text: Tonight is my very first sleepover at Honey's house!
But where will I sleep? Where do animals sleep?
Let's walk and find out, and be home before dark.
I can make a nest too! Look, I'm a birdie in my leaf nest! Tweet tweet!
Crunch, crunch!
Hee hee! Pip, you're too big for a nest!
Achoo! The leaves tickle my nose!
Tweet!
Oops! I woke up the birdies. Sorry, little birds!
How many little birds are in the nest? Count with me!
One, two, three! Three little birds!
What colour is this little bird? It's like the sky.
Blue! And one bird is pink, and one is yellow.
Birds sleep in a nest. They fluff up their soft feathers to stay warm.
Can you fluff up like a little bird? Puff, puff!
Night night, birdies. Who sleeps next? Let's tiptoe and see.
Look! A little round door in the ground. Who sleeps in there? Can you guess?
Long ears! It's a baby bunny!
Some bunnies sleep in a burrow. It's a cosy home under the ground.
Is the baby bunny up high, or down low?
Down low! Down under the ground.
Bunnies have big ears. Let's be very quiet. Can you whisper with me? Shh.
Shh. Sleep tight, baby bunny.
Splash!
Who is at the pond? Can you say quack quack?
Quack quack! Hello, Pip! It's me, Dotty!
Dotty, where do ducks sleep?
Ducks sleep near the water, at the edge of the pond.
I tuck my beak under my soft wing, like this. Can you tuck your nose under your arm?
Night night, Dotty. Birds in a nest, bunnies in a burrow, ducks by the pond.
One more friend! Ollie Owl. He must be very sleepy too.
Ollie lives in a hole in this big tree. Shh, he's sleeping.
Hoo, hoo!
Did you hear that? Who said hoo hoo?
Hoo hoo! Good evening, friends! I just woke up!
Woke up? But it's almost bedtime, Ollie!
Not for owls! Owls sleep in the daytime, and wake up at night.
So, when do owls sleep? In the day, or at night?
In the day! Silly owl. Ha ha!
Hoo hoo! Can you hoot with me? Hoo, hoo!
Now, Pip, where will a puppy sleep tonight?
Hmm. Not in a nest. Not in a burrow. Not by the pond.
Let's go home and see. The moon is up. Time for bed.
Surprise, Pip! A cosy basket bed, just for you!
Wow! A puppy bed! Thank you, Honey! Thank you, Mama Bunny!
Puppies like to curl up in a cosy bed. Just like me!
Let's sing our sleepy animal song!
Birdie sleeps in a nest, nest, nest. Flap your wings!
Bunny in a burrow takes a rest, rest, rest. Hop, hop!
Ducky by the pond tucks in tight. Tuck in!
Owl wakes up and says goodnight! Hoo hoo!
And puppy in his basket, snug and deep. Shh, shh, it's time to sleep.
Let's curl up like a puppy. Breathe in slowly.
And breathe out, so softly. Ahhh.
One more time! Flap like a bird, hop like a bunny, tuck like a duck, and hoot like an owl! Hoo hoo!

Are you ready for the next story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's Lulu Lamb's Brush Your Teeth Song. Let's watch!
Good morning! Last night, Lulu Lamb had a sleepover at Honey's house.
Good morning, Lulu!
Baa! Good morning, Honey. Let's go and play!

scenes.banner: Lulu Lamb's Brush Your Teeth Song

lines.text: Good morning, little ones! Before we play, what do we do with a toothbrush?
We brush our teeth!
Oh! But Mama Bunny, I forgot my toothbrush at home.
That's okay, Lulu. I have a little surprise for you.
Look! A brand new toothbrush. It is lavender, with a fluffy white cloud on it.
Lavender, like a bow. Fluffy, like soft wool. Whose toothbrush is it?
It's for you, Lulu! Your very own toothbrush, to keep at Honey's house.
For me? Baa! Thank you, Mama Bunny! It matches my lavender bow!
Lulu stood on the little pink step, so she could reach the sink.
Now, the toothpaste. How much do we need? A big, big blob? Or just a tiny bit?
Just a tiny bit, as small as a pea. A grown-up helps!
I am ready! Brush, brush, brush. Done!
Lulu brushed so fast! Little bubbles went everywhere.
Hee hee! Lulu, you have a bubble beard!
Oops! Was that too fast?
A little too fast, Lulu. Teeth like slow, gentle brushing. Let's sing a song, and brush slowly.
Everyone at home, hold up your finger like a toothbrush!
Sing with us!
Brush, brush, round and round!
Top teeth, bottom teeth, all around!
Little circles, soft and slow.
Sparkly smile, and off we go!
First, the front teeth! Show me a big smile!
Front teeth, front teeth, smile so wide.
Little circles, side to side!
Five little circles. Count with me! One, two, three, four, five!
Now, the top teeth, and the bottom teeth!
Top teeth up, and bottom teeth down.
Wiggle your toothbrush, round and round!
Can you brush your top teeth? Now your bottom teeth?
Now, the back teeth. They help us chew apples and carrots.
Back teeth, chewing teeth, way inside.
Open your mouth, and open wide!
Can you open wide, like a big yawn? Ahhh!
Ahhh! Brush, brush, way in the back!
Now, all together!
Brush, brush, round and round!
Top teeth, bottom teeth, all around!
Little circles, soft and slow.
Sparkly smile, and off we go!
Last of all, spit the bubbles into the sink. Then a little sip of water, and swish.
Spit, spit, swish, swish, all done.
Brushing teeth is so much fun!
Now let's look in the mirror. Honey, do I have a sparkly smile?
Yes! So sparkly! Can you show me your sparkly smile too?
Knock, knock! Who came to play? It was Pip Puppy!
Woof! Good morning! Lulu, why is your smile so sparkly?
I brushed slowly, with a song! Sing it with us, Pip!
Woof! I brush in the morning, and before bed too!
Sing it one more time, little friends!
Brush, brush, round and round!
Top teeth, bottom teeth, all around!
Little circles, soft and slow.
Sparkly smile, and off we go!
Brush in the morning, and before bed, with slow little circles. That's a sparkly smile!

Yay! It's Pip Puppy's Bubble Bath Song. Let's watch!
Splish, splash, bubbles in the tub!
Rub a dub, scrub, scrub, scrub!
Clap, clap!
The bubble bath is ready. Who is ready for a bath?
Not me! I like my muddy paws!
Pip! You have mud on your ears, mud on your nose, and mud on your tail!
But baths are wet. And I don't like water in my eyes.
I'll be right here with you, Pip, the whole time. Let's feel the water with one paw.
Ooh! Is the water hot, or cold, or just warm?
Just warm! Like a cosy hug.
In the bath, we always sit down. Sit, sit, sit.
I'm sitting! Hee hee. The bubbles tickle my nose.
Ah, ah, achoo!
Splash!
Hee hee! Pip, look! You have a bubble hat!
It's not a hat. It's a bubble crown! I am King Pip of Bubble Land!
Hello, King Pip! Can you make a royal wave?
Whoa! Big shiny bubbles are floating up!
How many big bubbles can you see? Count with me!
One, two, three, four, five! Five big bubbles!
Let's pop them, gently, with one finger. Hold up your popping finger!
Pop! Pop!
Two bubbles popped! How many bubbles are left?
Three! Pop, pop, pop!
Here come the bath toys! What colour is the little duck?
Yellow! A yellow duck!
And what colour is the boat? It's like the sky.
Blue! Sail, little boat, sail!
Splish!
And Mama has a cup. What colour is my cup?
Red! Yellow, blue and red!
Now, let's wash the mud away. Where are your ears? Point to your ears!
Scrub, scrub, my floppy ears!
Where is your nose? Can you touch your nose?
Here it is! Scrub, scrub, my little nose!
And your tummy, and your toes! Can you wiggle your toes?
Wiggle, wiggle! Hee hee, that tickles!
Now, the rinse. Tip your head back and close your eyes. I'll pour so gently.
Eyes closed. Head back. No water in my eyes!
Pip, you were so brave! And look, no more mud!
Squeak, squeak!
Did that duck say something? Is that Dotty Duckling? What do you think?
Quack quack! I'm right here, Pip!
That's a toy duck! It goes squeak. Real ducks go quack!
Ha ha! Hello, Dotty! Can you say quack like a real duck?
Ducks love water too! Can I sing your bath song with you?
The Bubble Bath Song! Sing with us!
Splish, splash, bubbles in the tub!
Rub a dub, scrub, scrub, scrub!
Wash your ears, and wash your nose. Point!
Wash your tummy, and your toes! Wiggle!
Pop the bubbles, one, two, three!
Pop, pop, pop!
Clean and happy, look at me!
Splish, splash, bubbles in the tub!
Rub a dub, scrub, scrub, scrub!
All done! Out we come, slowly. Hold my paw. Here's your fluffy towel.
I'm warm and clean and fluffy! Baths are fun!
Can you shake like a wet puppy? Shake, shake, shake!
Quack! Hee hee! Now I'm all wet too!
One more time! Scrub your tummy with me! Splish, splash, bubbles in the tub! Rub a dub, scrub, scrub, scrub!

Yay! It's Ollie Owl and the Sleepy Little Cloud. Let's watch!
Look up! Something fluffy is floating down!
Who is this fluffy friend? Can you guess?
It's a little cloud!

scenes.banner: Ollie Owl and the Sleepy Little Cloud

lines.text: Hello! I'm Cloudy. Aaah. I'm so sleepy.
I want to sleep up high with the big clouds. But I can't float up!
Up, up, up! Oh no. Down I come again.
Oh. Oh. Achoo!
Splish!
Hoo! Raindrops on my head! I'm a wet little owl!
Hee hee! Cloudy sneezed a tiny rain on Ollie!
Sorry, Ollie! My tummy is SO full of raindrops.
That's it! Clouds are made of tiny drops of water. When a cloud is full, what falls down?
Rain! Drip, drop!
But where can my rain go? I don't want to make my friends wet.
Look! Our flowers are droopy. They are thirsty!
How many thirsty flowers can you see? Count with me!
One, two, three!
Red, yellow and... what color is the last one?
Blue!
I can share my rain with the flowers!
Pitter, patter, pitter, patter.
Wiggle your fingers like rain! Pitter, patter!
Then, the last bit of sunshine peeked through the raindrops, and...
A rainbow! Cloudy, you made a rainbow!
Me? Wheee! And I feel light, like a feather!
Look, the flowers are standing up tall. They're smiling!
Sharing helped the flowers, and it helped you too, Cloudy.
Let's do a cloud stretch! Arms up high, big and fluffy.
Breathe in, and puff up big.
Breathe out, and float down soft.
Up, up, up floated Cloudy, and snuggled in with the big sleepy clouds.
Goodnight, Cloudy! Sweet dreams!
Sing with us! Pitter, patter, little rain. Drink up, flowers, grow again!
Puff up, Cloudy, light and high. Float to sleep up in the sky!

Are you ready for the last story? Say, yes!
Yay! It's Pip and the Night Light. Let's watch!
Psst! What glows at night? Can you guess?
Let's find out at our sleepover, Pip!
My very first sleepover! Woof, woof!
Pajamas on. Teeth brushed. Time for bed, little ones.
Night night, lamp!
Click!
Oh! It's very dark now.
Hmm. I'm not sure I like the dark.
That's okay, Pip. I'm right here. Let's look for the cosy lights of the night!
Ooh, look! A big shape on the wall, with long, long ears! Who could it be?
It's me! It's my shadow! Wiggle, wiggle!
My turn! Floppy ears and a waggy tail. Who is this shadow?
It's Pip! Woof, woof!
Shadows are silly, not scary!
Pip, look out the window! Who is glowing up there?
Hello, Pip! I'm the Moon. I glow softly, all night long.
Hello, Moon! You look so cosy.
What shape am I tonight? Draw it in the air with your finger!
A circle! Round and round and round!
Count my stars with me, Pip!
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
And one more, way up high! How many stars are there now?
Five! Five twinkly stars!
Let's make twinkle fingers, like stars! Open, close, open, close!
Twinkle, twinkle! My paws are little stars!
Hoo... hoo...
What was that? Who says hoo-hoo at night?
Let's peek outside together. Stay close to me.
Hoo-hoo! Good evening, Pip! It's me, Ollie Owl!
Ollie! You're awake?
Owls are awake at night. We sleep in the day!
Look! Little lights are blinking in the grass. Blink, blink!
Those are fireflies! Their tails glow. What colour is their light?
Yellow! A soft yellow glow!
Can I tell you a secret, Pip? The big, bright day is too sunny for my sleepy eyes!
Really? You feel a little unsure too?
Yes! So I snuggle in my cosy tree, and then I feel brave.
I can find my cosy too! Thank you, Ollie!
I have a little something for you, Pip. A star night light, all your own.
Can I turn it on? Ready? Count with me. One, two, three!
Click!
Wow! My star is glowing! The dark feels soft and cosy now.
Now you have a little star inside, and a big moon outside!
I made a Night Light Song! Sing it with me!
Glow, glow, little night light. Soft and yellow, warm and bright.
Moon is round, and stars say hi. Fireflies blink, and owls fly by.
Glow, glow, little night light. Cosy, cosy, sleepy night.
Let's do sleepy puppy breaths. Breathe in slowly, like smelling a warm cookie.
And breathe out, like blowing a dandelion. Whoosh.
Stretch your arms up, like a star. Now curl up small, like a sleepy puppy.
Yawn. I'm a sleepy puppy.
Goodnight, Moon. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, little night light.
Goodnight, Pip. I'll glow all night long.
Can you whisper goodnight too?
One more time! Make twinkle fingers and sing! Glow, glow, little night light. Cosy, cosy, sleepy night.
